data.one_liner: A cookie manager for Dio combining cookie_jar and Dio based on the interceptor algorithm.
data.what_it_does: It automatically manages and persists cookies for network requests made using the Dio HTTP client. It acts as an interceptor to load stored cookies into requests and save new cookies from responses.
use_when: You are using Dio for networking and need automatic cookie management
You need to persist cookies across app restarts using file storage
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio HTTP client
Your API is entirely stateless and does not use cookies
strengths: Seamless integration with Dio via interceptors
Supports persistent cookie storage using cookie_jar
Handles redirect requests and invalid cookies with specific options
weaknesses: Tied strictly to Dio and cookie_jar packages
Upgrading major versions of cookie_jar can lead to losing previously stored cookies
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package and attaching a CookieManager interceptor to your Dio instance.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Dart's core HTTP client instead of Dio and managing headers manually.
